exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Field Agent Clearance System
exercises.description: FINAL SECURITY CHECK: You're vetting a field agent for a high-risk vehicle operation. Input their age, license status ('True'/'False'), and insurance status ('True'/'False'). Print True ONLY if: Age ≥18 AND has license AND has insurance. One failure = mission scrubbed!
exercises.starterCode:
# Triple-verification security protocol
age = int(input())
has_license = input()
has_insurance = input()
exercises.solution:
age = int(input())
has_license = input()
has_insurance = input()
print(age >= 18 and has_license == 'True' and has_insurance == 'True')
